name: American Popular Culture Minor
intro: The interdisciplinary minor in American Popular Culture helps students to assess from a variety of perspectives the icons and ideas they encounter every day, to think critically about the images and assertions of the mass media and commercial culture, and to see the experience of popular culture as it interacts with questions of gender and ethnicity in the American context. Students choose five classes, including one

courses.title: The American War in Viet Nam
The Politics and Culture of the 1960s

groups.sub: Choose four courses (16 units), at least one from each of the groups below.
groups.rule: Critical Approaches to Popular Culture: choose one (4 units)

courses.title: America, the Frontier, and the New West

groups.sub: Choose four courses (16 units), at least one from each of the groups below.
groups.rule: Gender and Ethnicity in American Popular Culture: choose one (4 units)

groups.sub: Choose four courses (16 units), at least one from each of the groups below.
groups.rule: Popular Culture in the Arts: choose one (4 units)
